title: Just ok, not worth the price
text: Just ok, not worth the price. Just ok.  I’ve put together lots of cabinets and wardrobes, this one was a little frustrating.  Not really good quality, just ok and not really very sturdy.  The price should be half what it is for the quality, not a good value and not a beautiful cabinet but fits under the counter perfectly
